FR-001.title: Render the theme toggle anchored at the bottom of the sidebar on every non-Setup route

FR-002.title: Remove the separate top strip that previously only hosted the toggle

FR-003.title: Toggle stays fixed at the sidebar bottom regardless of menu length/scroll

FR-004.title: Toggle stays hidden on the Setup Wizard route, unchanged

FR-005.title: Clicking the toggle still switches light/dark theme

FR-006.title: Toggle's rendered footprint is at most 50% of its current size

FR-007.title: Toggle still visually/textually indicates the active theme

FR-008.title: Toggle retains an accessible name for its current theme/action

FR-009.title: Toggle's clickable target remains reliably usable despite the shrink

context: constraint: CLAUDE.md Toggle control standards — RadzenSwitch stays the control, no hand-rolled switch
intent: Relocate the theme toggle from its own top-bar strip to a pinned, >=50%-smaller control at the bottom of the sidebar menu, reclaiming screen space without changing its light/dark behavior.
expectations: Changing the Setup Wizard's own theme dropdown control is out of scope
Changing theme persistence, ThemeProvider logic, or the set of available themes is out of scope
approach: Move the .btn-theme-toggle block from the top-bar header into the bottom of the sidebar nav, drop the now-empty top-bar strip, and shrink the toggle's CSS footprint by >=50%; update ShellLayoutTests.cs selectors to match.
